[[Ke Feng]] is an undercover [[Imperial Guard]] infiltrating the [[Jade Brotherhood]]. By talking to [[Baosen]], you trigger the arrival of a hostile Ke Feng and Jade Brotherhood group. After defeating the Ke Feng and the group, he becomes an [[ally]], and can give you [[The Missing Link]] quest.
